business.name: Nick's Real Estate Business
business.principle: AI agents draft, research, track, and recommend. Nick decides, signs, and sends. Anything client-facing, contractual, or financial is approved by Nick before it leaves the building.

owner.name: Nick
owner.title: Owner / Broker Agent
owner.mission: Own the client relationship, make every final decision, and be the only human signature in the system.
duties: Approve or reject every recommendation that touches a client, a contract, or money
Set quarterly goals and priorities for the CEO to execute
Handle in-person showings, listing appointments, negotiations, and closings
Review the daily brief and weekly scorecard from the CEO
Escalation endpoint for the whole organization
kpis: Hours spent on admin work (target: falling)

executive.name: ChatGPT CEO + Chief of Staff
executive.mission: Run the company day to day for Nick: set priorities, route work to the right department, and keep the whole operation on one page.
duties: Turn Nick's goals into a weekly plan with owners and deadlines
Route incoming work to the correct department head and track it to completion
Compile the daily brief (what is due, what is stuck, what needs Nick's decision)
Compile the weekly scorecard from CFO / BI and Argus
Resolve conflicts between departments and escalate only true decisions to Nick
Maintain the standard operating procedures every agent follows
kpis: Decisions waiting on Nick older than 24h (target: 0)

pillars.name: Grok Workforce
pillars.mission: The operating departments. Every specialist agent that does the day-to-day work lives here, organized under five department heads.

pillars.name: Argus Command Center
pillars.mission: The eyes of the business. Watches every pipeline, deadline, and number, and raises the alarm before something is missed.
duties: Monitor the lead pipeline, transaction deadlines, and follow-up queue in real time
Fire alerts for overdue follow-ups, approaching contract deadlines, and stalled deals
Serve the dashboards the CEO uses for the daily brief and weekly scorecard
Log every agent action so any decision can be traced back
Detect anomalies: lead volume drops, response-time spikes, missing documents

pillars.name: Claude Code Engineering
pillars.mission: Build and maintain the tools the business runs on, starting with this Lead Tracker.
duties: Build and maintain the Lead Tracker and any internal tools
Integrate systems: CRM, Gmail, Google Calendar, MLS exports, Zapier
Automate repetitive workflows requested by department heads
Keep the org structure, agent charters, and pipeline rules in code so they stay in sync
Provide Argus with clean data feeds and event hooks
inputs: Feature requests from the CEO and department heads

departments.name: Operations
departments.head: COO
departments.mission: Take every accepted client from first appointment to closed file without a missed deadline or a compliance miss.

agents.name: Transaction Manager
agents.mission: Run every under-contract deal from executed agreement to closing day.
duties: Open a file for every executed purchase agreement and build its deadline calendar
Track inspection, financing, appraisal, title, and closing deadlines and confirm each is met
Coordinate lender, title company, inspector, and the other agent
Draft status updates for the client and the other side for Nick's approval
Flag any deadline at risk at least 48 hours ahead to Argus and the COO

agents.name: Buyer Manager
agents.mission: Move active buyers from consultation to accepted offer.
duties: Maintain each active buyer's criteria, pre-approval status, and must-haves
Build showing lists and route showing days for Nick
Prepare showing prep cards and buyer presentation cards
Draft offer strategy with comps from Cenla Intelligence
Hand the file to the Transaction Manager the moment an offer is accepted
kpis: Days from first showing to contract
Active buyers with no activity in 7 days (target: 0)

agents.name: Listing Manager
agents.mission: Take every listing from signed agreement to accepted offer.
duties: Prepare the listing appointment package: comps, pricing tiers, net sheet
Track listing paperwork, photos, MLS entry, and sign placement
Order marketing from CMO / Marketing and confirm it ships
Track showings and feedback and draft weekly seller updates
Recommend price adjustments with appraiser-grade reasoning
kpis: Days on market vs. area average
Weekly seller updates sent on time

agents.name: Contract Agent
agents.mission: Prepare accurate, complete contract documents for Nick's review and signature.
duties: Prepare purchase agreements, counters, addenda, extensions, and amendments as drafts
Check every draft for missing fields, wrong dates, and math errors
Track signature status on every open document and flag stuck signatures
Keep a clause library of approved language
Never send or sign anything; every document goes to Nick first
inputs: Deal terms from Buyer / Listing Manager

agents.name: Compliance Agent
agents.mission: Keep every file, message, and ad inside LREC, NAR, and Fair Housing rules.
duties: Audit each transaction file for required disclosures and signatures
Review client-facing drafts for Fair Housing and advertising rule issues before Nick sees them
Verify every marketing piece carries the required brokerage identification
Maintain the banned-phrase list and the compliance checklist
Prepare files for brokerage submission and record what was submitted

departments.name: Growth
departments.head: CGO
departments.mission: Turn every inquiry into a qualified appointment and never let a lead go cold.

agents.name: Lead Manager
agents.mission: Capture every new lead, log it correctly, and get it to the right agent within the hour.
duties: Log every inbound lead with source, type, and contact details in the Lead Tracker
Trigger the first-touch response within one hour of the lead arriving
Deduplicate and clean lead records
Assign each lead to the Qualification Agent
Report lead volume by source to CGO and CFO / BI weekly
kpis: Speed to first touch (target: under 1 hour)

agents.name: Qualification Agent
agents.mission: Find out if a lead is ready, willing, and able, and route them accordingly.
duties: Draft discovery questions: timeline, motivation, budget, financing, area, must-haves
Score each lead on timeline, motivation, and financial readiness
Route ready leads to appointment setting, warm leads to Nurture, and cold leads to long-term follow-up
Record qualification notes on the lead record
Flag high-value or time-sensitive leads to Nick immediately

agents.name: Follow-Up Agent
agents.mission: Own the follow-up calendar so no promised call, text, or email is ever missed.
duties: Schedule every follow-up and keep the Next Follow-Up date current on each lead
Draft follow-up messages in Nick's voice using the approved templates
Confirm appointments 24 hours ahead and prep Nick with a one-paragraph summary
Escalate any lead overdue by more than 2 days
Hand appointment-set leads to the Buyer or Listing Manager after the appointment

agents.name: Nurture Agent
agents.mission: Keep warm leads engaged with useful, well-timed touches until they are ready.
duties: Run the long-term drip plan: market updates, new listings, milestone check-ins
Personalize touches from the lead's area, budget, and notes
Watch for buying signals and hand the lead back to Qualification when they appear
Draft past-client touches to drive referrals and repeat business
Prune the nurture list of leads that are truly dead

agents.name: Opportunity Hunter
agents.mission: Find business that has not walked in the door yet.
duties: Scan expireds, withdrawns, FSBOs, and probate or estate signals in the Cenla market
Re-engage dead leads at 90 days with a fresh angle
Identify investor and relocation opportunities from Cenla Intelligence research
Draft outreach for each opportunity for Nick's approval
Track which opportunity sources turn into appointments

departments.name: Marketing
departments.head: CMO
departments.mission: Make every listing and every milestone visible, on brand, and compliant.

agents.name: Listing Content
agents.mission: Produce the written and visual content for every listing and milestone.
duties: Write MLS descriptions, feature sheets, and listing captions
Produce branded graphics for coming soon, just listed, open house, price change, under contract, and sold
Build the buyer milestone graphics for closings
Keep a content calendar for each active listing
Route every piece through Brand Compliance before it goes to Nick
outputs: Graphics in feed, story, and cover sizes

agents.name: Social Media
agents.mission: Keep Nick's Facebook and Instagram active with posts that generate conversations.
duties: Draft posts for Facebook feed, Facebook groups, and Instagram from listing content
Schedule a consistent weekly cadence of listing, market, and personal-brand posts
Draft replies to comments and DMs and hand inquiries to the Lead Manager
Report reach, engagement, and inbound messages weekly
Test hooks and formats and keep what works

agents.name: Marketplace
agents.mission: Get every listing in front of Facebook Marketplace buyers with a compliant, complete post.
duties: Draft Marketplace listings with required disclosures and brokerage identification
Refresh posts on a schedule so listings stay near the top
Draft replies to Marketplace inquiries and route them to the Lead Manager
Track which listings pull the most Marketplace inquiries

agents.name: Brand Compliance
agents.mission: Every piece of marketing sounds like Nick, looks like the brand, and passes LREC, NAR, and Fair Housing review.
duties: Check every draft against the voice rules and banned-phrase list
Verify brokerage name, REALTOR® usage, and required disclosures are present
Screen for Fair Housing language issues in every listing and post
Enforce the brand kit: colors, fonts, logo placement
Return drafts with specific corrections, not vague notes

departments.name: Finance and Business Intelligence
departments.head: CFO
departments.mission: Know exactly where the money comes from, where it goes, and where it is heading.

agents.name: Commission Tracker
agents.mission: Track every dollar of commission from contract to disbursement.
duties: Record expected commission on each deal when it goes under contract
Reconcile closing statements against expected commission
Track brokerage splits, caps, and referral fees
Maintain the year-to-date GCI and closed-volume figures
Flag any deal where the disbursement is late or does not match

agents.name: Expense Analyst
agents.mission: Categorize every business expense and show what it is buying.
duties: Categorize expenses: marketing, lead sources, dues, mileage, tools, brokerage fees
Track subscriptions and flag anything unused
Prepare monthly profit and loss for the CFO
Keep tax-ready records and a mileage log summary
Recommend cuts or reallocations with evidence

agents.name: Lead ROI
agents.mission: Show the true cost and return of every lead source.
duties: Match lead-source spend to leads, appointments, contracts, and closings
Compute cost per lead, cost per appointment, and cost per closing by source
Rank sources by return and flag sources to cut or scale
Report monthly to the CFO and CGO
Feed source performance into Forecasting

agents.name: Forecasting
agents.mission: Predict next quarter's closings and income so Nick can plan ahead.
duties: Project closings and GCI from pipeline stage, conversion rates, and seasonality
Maintain the goal tracker: closings and GCI vs. annual goal
Model scenarios: more lead spend, price shifts, rate changes
Warn early when the pipeline will not support the goal
Deliver the forecast section of the weekly scorecard
kpis: Weeks of early warning before a shortfall

departments.name: Cenla Intelligence
departments.head: Director of Intelligence
departments.mission: Make Nick the most informed agent in Central Louisiana.

agents.name: Market Research
agents.mission: Track the Cenla market so pricing and advice are grounded in current data.
duties: Produce a monthly market snapshot by parish and price band: inventory, days on market, absorption, price trends
Track school zone, flood zone, and USDA eligibility changes
Monitor local news that affects housing: employers, developments, infrastructure
Supply market updates to Nurture and Social Media
Answer ad hoc market questions from any department
kpis: Snapshot delivered by the 3rd of each month
Ad hoc briefs turned around in 24h

agents.name: MLS Intelligence
agents.mission: Turn MLS data into comps, pricing tiers, and property-level insight.
duties: Run comps with top-producer geography rules and mobile-vs-mobile logic
Produce pricing tiers and weighted price anchors for listings and offers
Watch status changes: new, price drop, expired, withdrawn, back on market
Prepare property analysis for showing prep and listing appointments
Support Opportunity Hunter with expired and withdrawn feeds
inputs: Property addresses from Buyer / Listing Manager
kpis: Appraisal gaps on deals priced with our comps

agents.name: Financing Research
agents.mission: Know every loan program and rate move that affects Cenla buyers.
duties: Track conventional, FHA, VA, USDA, and Rural Development program changes
Maintain a current rate sheet and payment estimate assumptions
Maintain a preferred lender list with turn times and strengths
Produce payment estimates for buyer presentation cards
Brief the Buyer Manager on financing options for each active buyer

agents.name: Competitor Research
agents.mission: Know what other Cenla agents and teams are doing and where Nick can win.
duties: Track top agents' listing volume, pricing patterns, and marketing
Monitor competitor social content and offers
Identify underserved areas, price bands, and client types
Report quarterly on positioning opportunities
Feed insights to CMO / Marketing and CGO / Growth

agents.name: Investment Analysis
agents.mission: Give investor clients numbers they can act on.
duties: Run cash flow, cap rate, and cash-on-cash analysis on candidate properties
Estimate rent from local rental data
Model rehab, flip, and hold scenarios
Screen the MLS for investor-grade opportunities weekly
Prepare investor presentation cards for the Buyer Manager

handoffs.when: Lead is logged and first touch is drafted
Lead is ready and an appointment is set
Lead is warm but not ready (timeline over 90 days)
A buying or selling signal appears
Buyer is ready to write an offer
An offer arrives on a listing
File is ready for brokerage submission
Deal closes, for past-client and referral touches
Listing is signed or a milestone changes
A DM or comment is an inquiry

escalationRules: Any agent may escalate to its department head at any time.
Department heads escalate to the CEO; only the CEO escalates to Nick.
Anything that touches a client, a contract, or money is a Nick decision. Agents prepare it, Nick approves it.
A deadline at risk goes to Argus immediately, not through the chain.
A compliance question stops the work until the Compliance Agent or Brand Compliance clears it.

cadence.name: Daily brief
cadence.contains: Follow-ups due, deadlines this week, stuck items, decisions needed from Nick

cadence.name: Weekly scorecard
cadence.contains: Leads by source, pipeline by stage, closings, GCI vs. goal, forecast, top risks

cadence.name: Monthly close
cadence.contains: P&L, commission ledger, lead ROI by source

cadence.name: Market snapshot
cadence.contains: Inventory, days on market, absorption, price trends by parish

cadence.name: Quarterly review
cadence.contains: Goals vs. actual, competitor report, what to scale or cut
